answer.reason: The valley is the place where the Philistines spread out their forces against David, told in the story of his early reign.

clauses.english: was where the Philistines spread themselves to seek David, and again a second time
clauses.quote: spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim

doubts: ISA 17:5 uses the valley only in a harvest comparison, so it is not an event and was left out.
JOS 15:8 and JOS 18:16 give only boundary markers, so they were not used.
